'''Brendon Brown''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 British Columbia Provincial Championship]] on 8 April 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]], according to Alan Sagan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d500">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-vancouver-british-columbia-4-08-00d500/ vancouver-british-columbia-4-08-00], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 10 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-vancouver-british-columbia-4-08-00d500/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
